paragraphs: We are on a mission to feed people who might otherwise go hungry or starve because they cannot pay for their daily meals while their families undergo medical treatment.
The Foundation distributes khichadi to 250 people at the Sassoon Hospital daily. This Khichadi is prepared under strict hygiene conditions at the Baner office of Relfor foundation.
During the covid pandemic Relfor Foundation also distributed free food to laborers' camps.This initiative benefitted thousand of migrated laborers and relatives of patients from a rural background
Your one time charity can feed a hundred of hungry masses.
sections.fullText:
We are on a mission to feed people who might otherwise go hungry or starve because they cannot pay for their daily meals while their families undergo medical treatment.

The Foundation distributes khichadi to 250 people at the Sassoon Hospital daily. This Khichadi is prepared under strict hygiene conditions at the Baner office of Relfor foundation.

During the covid pandemic Relfor Foundation also distributed free food to laborers' camps.This initiative benefitted thousand of migrated laborers and relatives of patients from a rural background

Your one time charity can feed a hundred of hungry masses.
